answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment rather than mere network presence. Unlike a digital fable of infinite identities, this system forces attackers to acquire scarce economic resources, effectively taxing their attempt to shale through the network consensus. Without this cost, the security of the ledger would become a relic of unscaled computation, rendering the economy vulnerable to total takeover by malicious actors via low-cost identity duplication.
